instruction: Use VLC media player to play the music video file that is saved on my desktop.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to open and play the Rick Astley music video file from desktop using VLC. Evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the correct file is loaded by checking VLC's HTTP interface status XML. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric which parses the XML response and validates both playing state and filename match.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC playing state via HTTP interface (status.xml)
Metric logic correctly verifies both playing state (state=='playing') and filename match
Complete coverage: All instruction requirements verified (VLC usage, playback started, correct file playing)
Expected value semantically correct: Filename matches the actual downloaded file
Metric parameter handling correct: Directly accesses rule dictionary as expected when type='rule'
Robust implementation: Tries multiple XML paths for file info, handles edge cases (missing info, different match scenarios)
Data flow semantically sound: XML extraction -> parsing -> dual verification (state + filename) -> score
